scripts.build: npm run build -w @facilityos/admin-web && npm run build -w @facilityos/staff-web && npm run build -w @facilityos/customer-web && npm run build -w @facilityos/mobile
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-facilityos --only auth,firestore "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:migration: node scripts/site-migration-plan.test.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-facilityos-migration --only firestore "node scripts/test-site-migration.mjs"
scripts.test:staff-browser: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-facilityos --only auth,firestore "npx tsx scripts/staff-browser-test.ts"
scripts.test:phase7-browser: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-facilityos --only auth,firestore "npx tsx scripts/phase7-browser-test.ts"
scripts.test:mobile-runtime: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-facilityos --only auth,firestore "npx tsx scripts/mobile-runtime-test.ts"
